title: Org chart within two levels
prompt: Using a recursive CTE named chain(id, name, depth) that starts at the CEO (id 1, depth 0) and traverses down through the staff16 table (manager_id references the manager's id), incrementing depth by 1 at each recursive step, return the name and depth of all employees who report to the CEO directly or indirectly, but only include those with depth less than or equal to 2.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE staff16 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, manager_id INTEGER); INSERT INTO staff16 VALUES (1,'Grace',NULL),(2,'Henry',1),(3,'Iris',1),(4,'Jack',2),(5,'Kim',3),(6,'Leo',4),(7,'Mona',5);
reference_sql: WITH RECURSIVE chain(id, name, depth) AS (SELECT id, name, 0 FROM staff16 WHERE id = 1 UNION ALL SELECT st.id, st.name, ch.depth + 1 FROM staff16 st JOIN chain ch ON st.manager_id = ch.id) SELECT name, depth FROM chain WHERE depth > 0 AND depth <= 2;
